competences.description: Inflicts damage that ignores all damage reduction effects on the enemy target and grants 1 Continuous Damage without a turn limit when the attack lands as a Critical Hit. In addition, the attack will always land as a Critical Hit when attacking a target without beneficial effects.
Attacks all enemies and grants 2 Continuous Damage without a turn limit each.

3 energy beads are released to attack the enemy that attacked the boss last whenever the boss is attacked 15 times. Decreases the target's Defense and grants Oblivion on the target for 2 turns each.
[Automatic Effect]

Attacks all enemies and monitors all enemies with the watcher's eye. While watching, steals the HP of the enemy gaining a turn by 15% and replaces 2 beneficial effects granted on the target with Continuous Damage without a turn limit each.
